summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Arabic RTL Student Registration Management System. All core features working correctly including authentication, dashboard, student registration with BMI calculation, student management, admin panel, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Backend authentication APIs (login, register, logout, /me endpoint)
Login with admin@admin.com / admin123 redirects to dashboard
Dashboard shows 3 schools, 0 students initially, 9 remaining seats after seed
Student registration form with school selection, personal info, BMI auto-calculation
Student registration saves successfully to Convex database
Student list page shows registered students with proper data
Student detail page displays complete student information and test results
Admin panel - schools management tab shows all 3 seeded schools
Admin panel - settings management tab loads correctly
RTL layout works correctly - sidebar on right, Arabic text properly aligned
Mobile responsive design - hamburger menu, stacked cards, proper navigation
Qatar flag colors (maroon #8A1538 and gold #D4AF37) implemented correctly
BMI calculation working: Height 170cm, Weight 65kg = BMI 22.5 (طبيعي)
Physical test scores recording (push-ups, sit-ups, flexibility, agility, endurance)
School capacity enforcement (max 3 students per school)
Data seeding with 3 Arabic schools: مدرسة الدوحة الثانوية (ثانوي), مدرسة الريان الإعدادية (إعدادي), مدرسة الوكرة الابتدائية (ابتدائي)
